title: Keurig K-Mini Plus Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker, with 6 to 12oz Brew Size, Stores up to 9 K-Cup Pods, Travel Mug Friendly, Misty Green
reviews: Kerig received with coupons that expired May 2023, a red flag. It would not work, trouble shooting done by manufacturer. Findings were defective purchase with an expired warranty. This happened the day item was received. Asked to send pics of pot with my name, date of purchase on paper in front of pot, model number, copy of proof of purchase, copy of post office tracking and delivery. Told no need to return, trash or recycle. After pics were received, immediately received email the info ie pics were not acceptable. Upon receiving Kerig a replacement would be sent. Followed by request for my physical address (I use PO Box) as UPS would pic item up at place of abode. I then receive email with bar code to use at Staples to return via UPS. So today after inconsistencies I’m going to Stables hopefully for a successful return. Problem is at manufacture in that they mail item not Amazon. They do not check model numbers, warranty expirations, and sell useless items. Poor PR for consumers. Forgot to mention the troubleshooter asked if had K pod in pot. Answered no, and stated per directions one is to first run water through FIRST before making first cup of coffee. Today February 1, 2024 I received email your Kerig is on the way. Unfortunately to physical address and not mailing address. I have PO Box for safety, live in multi apartment building where others take packages of others. This was explained in detail when they requested physical address. First Kerig was mailed to PO Box, so why not replacement?? If it is stolen as many packages are I’m in for more corespondency, and will request refund to charge card used for payment. Replacement Kerig mailed Monday of this week via UPS and received today Wednesday. The coffee maker works fine and I like the upgrade, btw no additional cost. It comes with large water reservoir so no need to add water for each cup. When warm weather come will try ice coffee feature, I’m sure it will work fine too. It took some time to resolve issue but it is now resolved. I would purchase Kerig products again, good maker, and customer support is accommodating.

I've owned several Keurigs in the past, including the ill fated Vue. I like this unit the best of all of them. But you have to understand it intended use and how it works to appreciate it. 1st, it doesn't pre-heat and stay hot like the bigger, multi-person units, when they are simply turned on. It only starts to heat when you press the big brew button. Once it's done with the brew the heater turns off, meaning it needs to pre-heat again for any additional cups. 2nd, after you press the brew button, you have to be patient as, unlike the multi-person, larger and more expensive units, it has to heat the cold water. For me and my cold tap water, this takes just under 3 minutes before the cup is complete. In the end, this unit is much more energy efficient as it isn't always heating when simply turned on. 4rd, if you are a single or maybe two person coffee household, this unit is perfect. If you have 3 or more drinkers or throw a lot of gatherings where coffee would be served, the bigger and more expensive multi-cup units would be better for you. What sets this unit apart from others is : 1) It's really small and doesn't take up much counter space, built-in cord storage and coffee bin are nice as well 2) It's really easy to keep clean, as there aren't a dozen things to take apart to clean or difficult places to try and shove paper towel into. 3) Does a good hot cup of coffee, no need to adjust temperature as it's comes up too hot to drink right away... Like a coffee maker should! 4) Water bin is easy to add/remove, easy to fill, easy to clean, easy to dry - compared to the multi-cup makers 5) Unlike other makers, the design is clean, modern, yet simple and doesn't have stupid curves or wasted spaces. This makes the unit easy to add water, brew, use and clean comparably 6) The design is so efficient that there's not a single drip, at least for me, once the brew is done. I'm used to other Keurigs which drip for a minute or two afterwards. The one design issue that affects impatient people is that the brew LED seems to have no rime or reason. You really can't rely on it to determine what step it is in during the brew. I just press the brew button, verify the LED is no longer solid for a couple seconds and walk away for a few minutes or listen for the empty air sound that occurs at the end of the brew cycle if I'm in the kitchen doing other things. In the end I highly recommend this maker for single or dual-household coffee drinkers or those who drink coffee irregularly. However, if you are an impatient person who can't value a small, easy to maintain, energy efficient coffee maker with a simple design, you will hate this coffee maker. It's coffee people, not rocket science. The quality and age of the coffee and pod design/filter are the most important factors. The coffee maker just disperses a controlled amount of hot water to the overall process. In this last factor, I find this unit to excel.

Writing this review after 15 days daily use in multi hotel travel - if you want a good cup of coffee vs hotel's get this. We filled k-cup with coffee from home & bought local roaster's grind which fit in case's pouch. Machine easy quick and Hot. Only lesson learned is run water thru clean k-cup to clean unit before packing up - tilting the unit on luggage rolling to/from car it drips a little. Makes a good cup just like home.

Bought this in January of 2024 and it's still going strong now. Everytime I have issues with it, it turns out that it just needs to be cleaned and then it works just fine again. Compared to coffee pots from other brands I personally feel like it makes a higher quality cup of coffee. Other machines I've had have felt diluted like they're not mixing the coffee as well or as strong as it should be, but this one does as well as my old keurig. Never should have thrown that one out but this one does the job. You have to fill the reservoir for each individual cup of coffee, but that doesn't really bother me personally. It detaches on my model and isn't much of a hassle at all. Mine also has a "strong" setting but honestly I've tried it maybe one or two times and don't prefer it. Just not for me but maybe for other people. Another nice plus is that it's pretty small. I will say, it's tall but thin, so it's small horizontally but not much shorter vertically than other machines. There are two reasons this gets 4 stars instead of 5. For one, the thing is pretty loud for a coffee pot. Loud enough that it'll definitely be your first thought as soon as it gets going, but it isn't disturbingly loud by any means unless quiet is of the utmost importance for some reason. The second reason it gets 4 stars is that it's slow. I haven't personally timed how long it takes but I've had three other k-cup coffee pots and this one is by far the slowest. It takes no more than five minutes I believe but any other one I've had takes maybe one or two. Not a long time in the long run but slow for a keurig. Still, this thing is going strong after a little over a year and makes really solid coffee, so the two small complaints I have with it are not a big deal. Would recommend.

Updated review: I dealt with issue explained below In my original review for awhile and then finally got around to calling Keurig Customer Care on 23-July... AWESOME experience! First, expecting to hold 5-10 mins to get thru, nope, they answered immediately! Literally a zero second wait time! Rep was great - feel bad now for not catching her name(or asking again at the end)...she listened to my issue without interrupting me, then asked a few questions/ walked me thru some trouble shooting steps. Then had me “brew” a cup (no pod) and it worked as designed, we waited a couple minutes and “brewed” another...and the issue occurred again...pulled in about an ounce of water and quit. Fast forward the story...my new machine is already being shipped under their warranty! Since we love the machine (slim, easy to put away for those like us who don’t like it on the counter 24x7, and brews a nice hot cup), since they offer great customer service and stand behind their warranty without tons of hoops to jump thru, I’m back to rating as 5 stars. We know plenty of people with various Keurig machines who have never had a problem, so chalking this one I had up as an anomaly. I’ll follow up if any concerns with the replacement. Original Review at 10-months: Purchased 1-Aug-2019 and now in June 2020 we are experiencing issues... it will work fine sometimes but other times it doesn’t. It started in May were it worked 90% of the time but now in June it’s a 50/50 chance. When it doesn’t work, it will only draw in an ounce or two of the water and then just stop. It takes several times of pushing the start/brew button over 15-20 minutes before it pulls in all the water, heats up and dispenses. The last two mornings this issues started with the very first brew of the day. And 20+ minutes later when it did finally dispense, it was only a half cup (but all of the water had finally been drawn into the unit). When it works properly we love it. Easy to use and clean. But it appears that the overall quality - in terms of longevity - isn’t there. Maybe we just got a bad one, so watch for other reviews provide at/near the 1 year mark, because 3 months in I would have highly recommended this model.... now I’m backing away from that recommendation unfortunately.

Compact single serve coffee maker. Sleek design fits anywhere. Electric cord length is approximately 26’’ from coffee maker to tip of cord. Machine is loud when it starts but only for a short time then it pauses and starts to brew with about the same noise as other Keurig’s. Takes less than 2 minutes to brew but I’d definitely longer than our other machine. Best selling point is the removable water container. Makes washing so much more convenient and easy.

Another Edit: Contacted Keurig to get a FOURTH replacement because they won't give me a refund. After jumping through a ridiculous amount of hoops, and at one point they wouldn't even send a replacement, I had to go through the troubleshooting again and when it didn't work, she agreed to send a replacement. Then she wanted the order number, which I had already given her, so she said she wanted to order number from Keurig. I DON'T HAVE AN ORDER NUMBER FROM KEURIG!!! I didn't order it from Keurig. I ordered it from Amazon so now she said they can't send me a replacement. I finally screamed at her and hung up. Worst company in the world, besides the fact that it is extremely difficult to understand the rep. I had to repeatedly ask her to repeat what she said. Sometimes, I could only understand maybe one out of ten words and then try to decipher what she said. I can't say enough bad things about Keurig. I offered to send all three back, just for the record. I highly recommend the Ninja single serve that uses K-cups plus it has a basket that you can use ground coffee. I freaking love it. Thanks to my wonderful, generous niece who heard my story about the Keurig and got me the Ninja at Christmas. I am in love and will never buy another Keurig product. Edit: third coffee pot they sent still does the same thing. Works a few times, then it won't for about 10-12 times. Worst piece of cr@p I've ever bought in my life. I don't see.the point in getting a 4th one. Sick of this. The first one I received would occasionaly work but many times not until running it thru the steps six times, then it would finally brew. Was sent a replacement and it had the same issue tho not as frequently. Just received another replacement and it worked on the first try but don't know of it will continue. Also, the "strong" brew button doesn't seem to have any effect on any of the 3 machines. Wanted to replace my larger original 2.0 machine because I don't like the fact that you can't drain the water out to clean it. The single serve doesn't hold water inside of it but it also doesn't brew all of the time. I have spent as long as half an hour repeating the process without it ever heating the water. It empties the reservoir and then just sits there until it turns off. If this third one has the same issue, I might take a hammer to it and smash it to smithereens. And customer service is extremely difficult to understand. Had to keep asking her over and over to repeat what she said. Some of it I never figured out. Frustrating.

I love the size and the color. This is perfect for our house as I’m the only one that drinks coffee and I typically only drink one cup daily. I love the “strong” option. It takes up very little counter space and I liked that it had a pod storage container that fits in it to have a streamlined “closed” appearance. I’ve been using it almost daily for quite a while and it still works perfectly. It’s also really easy to clean and maintain. I ran a water/vinegar cycle through it to clean it out and wash any mineral residual away and was pleasantly surprised at how clear the liquid was after going though the system.
